a_record_probs.hypotheses: iid arrivals nu_j; state-independent write types; expiration then write; last write wins; r_j>0
a_record_probs.se_note: bin and late-window SEs are max(empirical seed SE, model SE with lag-k autocorrelation alpha_j^k); late coverage = CI covers OR |meas-pred| <= 0.005 (degenerate CIs at coverage 1 or 0)
a_record_probs.criterion: PASS if mean fraction of 250-epoch bins with |z|<2 >= 0.90 and late-window prediction is covered (CI or 0.005 tolerance) in >= 0.90 of (cell,state,config)

b_finite_memory.kind: IDENTITY + sampling check (in-sample primitives); OUT-OF-SAMPLE prediction (probing primitives, probing nu)
b_finite_memory.oos_note: unpaired OOS measurement contains the cold-term shift N*J_U(eta_U^probe) on id_test; paired removes it
b_finite_memory.criterion: IDENTITY PASS if paired task-bootstrap CI covers the prediction in >= 0.90 of (config,N) points and median normalised error at N=20000 < 0.05; OOS PASS if sign agrees in >= 0.80 of configs and median normalised error < 0.15

c_stationary_sign.result: thm:memory stationary criterion eta_inf >= eta_U iff sum_j nu_j G_j >= 0; eq:app-memory-relative-efficiency
c_stationary_sign.kind: IN-SAMPLE hypothesis test (primitives = population of the stream) and OUT-OF-SAMPLE (probing primitives)
c_stationary_sign.criterion: PASS if accuracy >= 0.95 among conclusive configs (in-sample) and both signs occur among predictions

d_noise_threshold.kind: IN-SAMPLE / OUT-OF-SAMPLE hypothesis test per cell
d_noise_threshold.criterion: PASS if sign accuracy >= 0.90 among conclusive hypothesis-met cell-configs; flagged one-sided if no conclusive cell-config has a predicted negative sign
d_noise_threshold.verdict_in: PASS (one-sided: only the err<thr side is conclusive in-sample)

f_regret.result: app:memory-regret eq:app-regret (delta=0, empty start, s = v - eta_U c, s^O = best fixed arm per cell)
f_regret.kind: IDENTITY + sampling check (in-sample); OUT-OF-SAMPLE prediction (probing primitives)
f_regret.criterion: IDENTITY PASS if CI covers in >= 0.90 of points and median relative error at N=20000 < 0.05; OOS PASS if median relative error < 0.15

e_retention.result: app:retention eq:app-ttl (TTL coverage), eq:app-fifo (FIFO coverage), and the statement that E -> M/beta in eq:app-ttl is NOT exact for the FIFO
e_retention.kind: IDENTITY + sampling check for the two formulas; IN-SAMPLE hypothesis test of the inexactness statement
e_retention.replay: dedicated 300-seed x 20000-epoch replay with the same real-outcome write mechanism; FIFO measured only on epochs where >= M writes have occurred
e_retention.audit_note: 2026-09-11: seed_ci now drops seeds with an undefined (NaN) FIFO mean; in the original run the 17 cell points and the aggregate at theta=1, beta_fa=0, M=1000 were NaN and were counted as not covered (FIFO coverage 0.907 -> see frac_fifo_covered)
e_retention.criterion: formulas PASS if prediction covered (CI or 0.005) in >= 0.90 of (cell,E) points; inexactness PASS if among resolvable points (|naive-exact| > 2 SE, M<=20) the measurement is closer to the exact formula in >= 0.90 and the exact formula is rejected in < 0.10 of them, and the aggregate arriving-cell coverage rejects the naive formula in >= 0.50 of M<=20 configs

j9_variant.result: eq:finite-memory identity and stationary sign criterion with J = 9 dimension cells (theta x bfa in {0,0.2} x cold x resource)
j9_variant.kind: IDENTITY + sampling check; IN-SAMPLE sign test

overhead.kind: IDENTITY + sampling check (identity) and IN-SAMPLE hypothesis test (threshold sign vs measured eta_inf - eta_0)
overhead.instantiation: memory-enabled cold state = cold policy + one shadow call (uniform model, real billed cost); no-memory reference = cold policy alone (same value, cost c_0); h = mean shadow cost
overhead.criterion: identity PASS if CI covers prediction in all configs; threshold PASS if sign accuracy = 1 among conclusive configs

g_tail.result: thm:tail: TTL deficit Theta(E^{-(z-1)/z}); cumulative deficit Theta(N^{1/z}); Zipf, clean writes, common omega, common Delta
g_tail.kind: mechanism = IDENTITY + sampling check (exact finite-J occupancy sums); exponent = asymptotic prediction tested at finite E, N (semi-synthetic Zipf over real tasks)
g_tail.criterion: mechanism PASS if seed-CI covers the exact finite-J sum in >= 0.90 of points; exponent PASS if |fitted slope - target| <= 0.10 for all z (both TTL and cumulative); if exponent fails but the theorem's own infinite sum has the same finite-range slope (within 0.03 of measured) -> INCONCLUSIVE (finite range), not FAIL

h_arm_reveal.result: lem:app-arm-reveal: P(suboptimal recommendation after v visits) <= (1-e_{m*})^v; convergence to best-in-support if e_{m*}=0
h_arm_reveal.kind: probability bound (IDENTITY-type) + sampling check; arms = 8 models, mu_m = real id_test mean score per 21-cell, exact reveal
h_arm_reveal.criterion: PASS if the bound is violated (measured > bound + 2.5 SE) in < 1% of (cell, v) points for every e-configuration and convergence fraction >= 0.99

stream.nu_source: empirical id_test cell frequencies (population of the stream)

zipf.cell_task_assignment: uniform with replacement from eligible tasks (a task may serve several cells)
zipf.logger: on arrival, with prob omega the logger evaluates all models on the real task and records the cheapest hitting model (exact reveal, clean)

fifo_mark_law_humaneval.note: all four retention configs share one replay stream, so per-cell deviations are correlated across (config, M)
